visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) A young woman with long dark hair, wearing a white floral patterned dress, sits at a marble-textured table in a bright indoor cafe. She holds a small white paper cup containing a green tea and vanilla swirled soft-serve ice cream and a small wooden spoon. Four identical cups are arranged in front of her on the table. In the background, a professional stainless steel soft-serve machine and a digital order screen are visible under bright studio-style lighting. (2) The camera cuts to a closer medium shot. The woman gestures with her wooden spoon while speaking with an expressive, joyful facial expression and squinted eyes. Yellow and white variety captions appear centered at the bottom of the frame. (3) She brings the ice cream cup closer to the camera lens, smiling broadly as if sharing the treat with the viewer. The background remains the brightly lit cafe interior with a 'NAP TEA' logo visible on the machine. (4) She leans forward, resting her arms on the table as if to encircle and protect the five cups of ice cream. Her expression is playful and greedy in a humorous way. (5) The shot returns to her eating the ice cream. She takes a bite with the wooden spoon, closing her eyes in satisfaction and nodding. More stylized text overlays appear as she expresses her enjoyment.
